notes.title: 🌟 THE 2025 YEARLY UPDATE IS HERE! 🌟
notes.notes:
Our annual free update has arrived! As always, we're keeping our promise to deliver yearly content at no extra cost to our valued users.

✨ Your 2025 Yearly Update Includes:
Complete 2025 Horoscopes & Predictions
Fresh 2025 Numerology Insights
New Astrological Forecasts for the Year Ahead
Updated Zodiac Compatibility Charts

🌎 Plus New Languages:
¡Hola! Now available in Spanish
Olá! Available in Portuguese (Brazil & Portugal)

As with every yearly update, all new content is completely FREE for existing users. Simply update your app to continue your cosmic journey into 2025!

notes.title: Astrology and Horoscope Premium got a major update! (2.4.0)
notes.notes:
2.4.0 MAJOR UPDATE
* Added Touchscreen support (chosen at start screen).
* Fixed bug: Chinese sign dates fixed.
* Game runs smoother now with more FPS.
* Changed the font to a more modern.
* Uses less memory and loads faster.
* Added 1 language: Japanese.
* Major game engine update.
* Graphics quality is a lot better.
* Other bugs fixed.

notes.title: 2019 Version is out (2.0v). Completely redesigned from scratch
notes.notes:
Version 2 is out.
1) Completely redesigned from scratch.
2) Now is full of particles, effects and super polished.
3) Now up to 5 persons can be saved.
4) Daily Predictions have now details with text.
5) Living room multiplayer!
6) Export outcome to your email.
7) Many UI improvements.
8) Animation everywhere.
9) Translated into German, French and Greek.
10) Runs on Linux 32bit/64bit, Windows 32bit/64bit, Mac OSX 64bit.
